NKJV.1: Then I turned and raised my eyes, and saw there a flying scroll.
NKJV.2: And he said to me, “What do you see?” So I answered, “I see a flying scroll. Its length is twenty cubits and its width ten cubits.”
NKJV.3: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the face of the whole earth: ‘Every thief shall be expelled,’ according to this side of the scroll; and, ‘Every perjurer shall be expelled,’ according to that side of it.”
NKJV.4: “I will send out the curse,” says the LORD of hosts; “It shall enter the house of the thief And the house of the one who swears falsely by My name. It shall remain in the midst of his house And consume it, with its timber and stones.”
NKJV.5: Then the angel who talked with me came out and said to me, “Lift your eyes now, and see what this is that goes forth.”
NKJV.6: So I asked, “What is it?” And he said, “It is a basket that is going forth.” He also said, “This is their resemblance throughout the earth:
NKJV.7: Here is a lead disc lifted up, and this is a woman sitting inside the basket”;
NKJV.8: then he said, “This is Wickedness!” And he thrust her down into the basket, and threw the lead cover over its mouth.
NKJV.9: Then I raised my eyes and looked, and there were two women, coming with the wind in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between earth and heaven.
NKJV.10: So I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are they carrying the basket?”
NKJV.11: And he said to me, “To build a house for it in the land of Shinar; when it is ready, the basket will be set there on its base.”

ESV.6: And I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the basket  that is going out.” And he said, “This is their iniquity  in all the land.”

ESV.8: And he said, “This is Wickedness.” And he thrust her back into the basket, and thrust down the leaden weight on its opening.

ESV.11: He said to me, “To the land of Shinar, to build a house for it. And when this is prepared, they will set the basket down there on its base.”

NLT.1: I looked up again and saw a scroll flying through the air.
NLT.2: “What do you see?” the angel asked. “I see a flying scroll,” I replied. “It appears to be about 30 feet long and 15 feet wide. ”
NLT.3: Then he said to me, “This scroll contains the curse that is going out over the entire land. One side of the scroll says that those who steal will be banished from the land; the other side says that those who swear falsely will be banished from the land.
NLT.4: And this is what the LORD of Heaven’s Armies says: I am sending this curse into the house of every thief and into the house of everyone who swears falsely using my name. And my curse will remain in that house and completely destroy it — even its timbers and stones.”
NLT.5: Then the angel who was talking with me came forward and said, “Look up and see what’s coming.”
NLT.6: “What is it?” I asked. He replied, “It is a basket for measuring grain, and it’s filled with the sins of everyone throughout the land.”
NLT.7: Then the heavy lead cover was lifted off the basket, and there was a woman sitting inside it.
NLT.8: The angel said, “The woman’s name is Wickedness,” and he pushed her back into the basket and closed the heavy lid again.
NLT.9: Then I looked up and saw two women flying toward us, gliding on the wind. They had wings like a stork, and they picked up the basket and flew into the sky.
NLT.10: “Where are they taking the basket?” I asked the angel.
NLT.11: He replied, “To the land of Babylonia, where they will build a temple for the basket. And when the temple is ready, they will set the basket there on its pedestal.”

AMP.1: Again I looked up, and I saw a scroll flying in the air!
AMP.2: And the angel said to me, "What do you see?" And I answered, "I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits (thirty feet) and its width is ten cubits (fifteen feet)."
AMP.3: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the face of the whole land; for everyone who steals will be cut off according to the writing on one side, and everyone who swears [oaths falsely] shall be cut off according to the writing on the other side.
AMP.4: I will send the curse out," declares the LORD of hosts, "and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of the one who swears falsely by My name; and it will spend the night in that house and consume it, both its timber and its stones."
AMP.5: Then the angel who was speaking with me came forward and said to me, "Now look up and see what this is going forth."
AMP.6: And I said, "What is it?" And he said, "This is the ephah (grain basket) going forth. This," he continued, "is their appearance throughout the land
AMP.7: (and behold, a [round, flat] lead cover was lifted up); and there sat a woman inside the ephah."
AMP.8: Then he said, "This is Wickedness (Godlessness)!" And he threw her back down into the middle of the ephah and threw the lead cover on its opening.
AMP.9: Then I looked up, and there were two women coming out with the wind in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heavens.
AMP.10: I said to the angel who was speaking with me, "Where are they taking the ephah?"
AMP.11: And he said to me, "To the land of Shinar (Babylon) to build a temple for her; and when it is prepared, she shall be set there on her own pedestal."

NIV.1:
The Flying Scroll
I looked again—and there before me was a flying scroll!
NIV.2:
He asked me, “What do you see?”
I answered, “I see a flying scroll, thirty feet long and fifteen feet wide.”
NIV.3: And he said to me, “This is the curse that is going out over the whole land; for according to what it says on one side, every thief will be banished, and according to what it says on the other, everyone who swears falsely will be banished.
NIV.4: The Lord Almighty declares, ‘I will send it out, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of him who swears falsely by my name. It will remain in his house and destroy it, both its timbers and its stones.’”
NIV.5:
The Woman in a Basket
Then the angel who was speaking to me came forward and said to me, “Look up and see what this is that is appearing.”
NIV.6:
I asked, “What is it?”
He replied, “It is a measuring basket.” And he added, “This is the iniquity of the people throughout the land.”
NIV.7: Then the cover of lead was raised, and there in the basket sat a woman!
NIV.8: He said, “This is wickedness,” and he pushed her back into the basket and pushed the lead cover down over its mouth.
NIV.9: Then I looked up—and there before me were two women, with the wind in their wings! They had wings like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.

NIV.11: He replied, “To the country of Babylonia to build a house for it. When it is ready, the basket will be set there in its place.”

NET.1: Then I turned to look, and there was a flying scroll!
NET.2: Someone asked me, “What do you see?” I replied, “I see a flying scroll thirty feet long and fifteen feet wide.”
NET.3: The speaker went on to say, “This is a curse traveling across the whole earth. For example, according to the curse whoever steals will be removed from the community; or on the other hand (according to the curse) whoever swears falsely will suffer the same fate.”
NET.4: “I will send it out,” says the LORD who rules over all, “and it will enter the house of the thief and of the person who swears falsely in my name. It will land in the middle of his house and destroy both timber and stones.”
NET.5: After this the angelic messenger who had been speaking to me went out and said, “Look, see what is leaving.”
NET.6: I asked, “What is it?” And he replied, “It is a basket for measuring grain that is moving away from here.” Moreover, he said, “This is their ‘eye’ throughout all the earth.”
NET.7: Then a round lead cover was raised up, revealing a woman sitting inside the basket.
NET.8: He then said, “This woman represents wickedness,” and he pushed her down into the basket and placed the lead cover on top.
NET.9: Then I looked again and saw two women going forth with the wind in their wings (they had wings like those of a stork) and they lifted up the basket between the earth and the sky.
NET.10: I asked the messenger who was speaking to me, “Where are they taking the basket?”
NET.11: He replied, “To build a temple for her in the land of Babylonia. When it is finished, she will be placed there in her own residence.”

MSG.1: I looked up again and saw—surprise!—a book on the wing! A book flying!
MSG.2:
The Messenger-Angel said to me, "What do you see now?"
I said, "I see a book flying, a huge book—thirty feet long and fifteen wide!"
MSG.3: He told me, "This book is the verdict going out worldwide against thieves and liars. The first half of the book disposes of everyone who steals; the second half takes care of everyone who lies.
MSG.4: I launched it"—Decree of God-of-the-Angel-Armies—"and so it will fly into the house of every thief and every liar. It will land in each house and tear it down, timbers and stones."
MSG.5: The Messenger-Angel appeared and said, "Look up. Tell me what you see."
MSG.6:
I said, "What in the world is that?"
He said, "This is a bushel basket on a journey. It holds the sin of everyone, everywhere."
MSG.7: Then the lid made of lead was removed from the basket—and there was a woman sitting in it!
MSG.8: He said, "This is Miss Wicked." He pushed her back down into the basket and clamped the lead lid over her.
MSG.9: Then I looked up and to my surprise saw two women flying. On outstretched wings they airlifted the bushel basket into the sky.
MSG.10: I said to the Messenger-Angel, "Where are they taking the bushel basket?"
MSG.11: He said, "East to the land of Shinar. They will build a garage to house it. When it's finished, the basket will be stored there."
